تبتلعين (form VIII)
# تَبْتَلِعِينَ (tabtaliʕīna) /tab.ta.li.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# تُبْتَلَعِينَ (tubtalaʕīna) /tub.ta.la.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
